kingdoms.name: Kingdom of the Sun
kingdoms.motto: Where authority is sacred, and crowns are heavy.
kingdoms.description: The Lion Kingdom is the seat of imperial unity. Kings are not chosen to be loved, but to carry the burden of rule. Justice is public. Power is visible. Failure is remembered.

kingdoms.name: The Land That Remembers
kingdoms.description: Elephant elders carry the living memory of K'Thari. Their rulings are slow, deliberate, and almost never wrong. The past is not past here. It is law.

kingdoms.name: The Waiting Waters
kingdoms.description: The Crocodile Kingdom rules the great waterways and hidden deltas. Their power is not speed, but inevitability. What enters their domain is already being judged.

kingdoms.name: The Hidden Crown
kingdoms.description: The Leopard Kingdom does not march armies — it moves individuals. Assassins. Scouts. Tacticians. Infiltrators. They are the invisible hand of K'Thari.

kingdoms.name: The Unbroken Heights
kingdoms.motto: Where power is mastered, not displayed.
kingdoms.description: The Gorilla Kingdom believes true strength is control. Warriors train in silence. Kings rule through restraint. Their mountains produce soldiers who do not break.

kingdoms.name: The Coiled Dominion
kingdoms.description: The Serpent Kingdom does not rule land — it rules information. Spies, whispers, contracts, poisons, betrayals. They rarely fight wars. They end them before they begin.

kingdoms.name: The Devouring Lands
kingdoms.motto: Where survival has rotted into cruelty.
kingdoms.description: The Hyena territories are what remain when desperation becomes culture. They raid. They scavenge. They conquer because they must. They are not evil. They are starving.

secretText: That which belongs to all. And the Owl watches over every crown.
secretTraits: Balance · Prophecy · Ancient Law · Symbol: The Owl
secretMotto: It has no throne. No army. No borders.
secretDescription: This is not a kingdom. It is the spiritual and mythic heart of the continent. The Owl does not rule. It watches.
secretTitle: The Secret Lands — That Which Belongs to All
